videos.headline: Alabama prepares for MS State's cowbells, defensive challenge
videos.description: Yea Alabama's Emily Grace McWhorter joins SEC This Morning to discuss No. 7 Alabama's focus on defensive discipline and how the Tide is preparing for the cowbell-heavy atmosphere at No. 16 MS State.

videos.headline: Mark Keenum thrilled about Mississippi State's competitiveness
